```{r setting}
# Clear global workspace
rm( list = ls( envir = globalenv() ), envir = globalenv() )

library("ggthemes")
library("tidyverse")
library("patchwork")
library("export")
library("e1071")
library("scales")
library("RColorBrewer")
library("zoo")
library("plotly")

# define createEmptyDf
createEmptyDf = function( nrow, ncol, colnames = c() ){
  data.frame( matrix( vector(), nrow, ncol, dimnames = list( c(), colnames ) ) )
}
```

```{r setting}
# TrackMate frame indices start at 0 by default.
# Example: analysis starting at the fifth image corresponds to frame index 4.
analysis_start_frame <- 0 

# Convert the acquisition interval (10 minutes) to hours, accounting for analysis of every tenth frame.
time_interval <- 10/60*10 

# Spatial calibration in micrometers per pixel (camera pixel size: 6.45 µm).
scale = 0.0645 # 100x objective
```

```{r get_dir_path}
# Find all analysis_round_* directories
round_dirs <- list.dirs(path = "../4_tracking/4.2_Trackmate", recursive = FALSE)
round_dirs <- round_dirs[grepl("^analysis_round_[0-9]+$", basename(round_dirs))]

# Find Spot and Edge CSV files in each csv_results directory
spot_file_list <- unlist(lapply(round_dirs, function(dir) {
  list.files(path = file.path(dir, "csv_results"),
             pattern = "(^|_)spots\\.csv$",
             full.names = TRUE,
             ignore.case = TRUE
             )
  }))

edge_file_list <- unlist(lapply(round_dirs, function(dir) {
  list.files(
    path = file.path(dir, "csv_results"),
    pattern = "(^|_)edges\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
}))
```

```{r import}
# Read TrackMate CSV files, keeping the second line as the header
read_trackmate_csv <- function(file) {
  lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
  lines <- lines[-c(1, 3, 4)]
  read.csv(text = paste(lines, collapse = "\n"), header = TRUE)
}

# Read each CSV file and combine the results.
max_spot_id <- 0
raw_spot_data <- 
  lapply(spot_file_list, function(file) {
    df <- read_trackmate_csv(file)
    df$Signal.Noise.ratio.ch1 <- as.character(df$Signal.Noise.ratio.ch1)
    df$Spot.ID <- df$Spot.ID + max_spot_id
    print(max_spot_id)
    max_spot_id <<- max(df$Spot.ID, na.rm = T) # Update the variable in the parent environment by <<-
    return(df)
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Read each CSV file and combine the results.
max_spot_id <- 0
raw_edge_data <- 
  lapply(edge_file_list, function(file) {
    df <- read_trackmate_csv(file)
    df$Source.spot.ID <- df$Source.spot.ID + max_spot_id
    df$Target.spot.ID <- df$Target.spot.ID + max_spot_id
    print(max_spot_id)
    max_spot_id <<- max(df$Target.spot.ID, na.rm = T) # Update the variable in the parent environment by <<-
    return(df)
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Check for duplicate Spot IDs.
duplicated_spots <- raw_spot_data[duplicated(raw_spot_data$Spot.ID), ]

if (nrow(duplicated_spots) > 0) {
  message("Duplicate Spot IDs found:")
  print(duplicated_spots)
} else {
  message("No duplicate Spot IDs found.")
}
```

```{r export_merged_data}
# Exports data by merging several files with distinct spot IDs.

# Find Spot and Edge CSV files in each csv_results directory
all_spots_file_list <- unlist(lapply(round_dirs, function(dir) {
  list.files(path = file.path(dir, "csv_results"),
             pattern = "(^|_)allspots\\.csv$",
             full.names = TRUE,
             ignore.case = TRUE
             )
  }))

# CSVファイルを読み込み、リストに格納
max_spot_id <- 0
raw_all_spots_data <- 
  lapply(all_spots_file_list, function(file) {
    df <- read_trackmate_csv(file)
    df$Signal.Noise.ratio.ch1 <- as.character(df$Signal.Noise.ratio.ch1)
    df$Spot.ID <- df$Spot.ID + max_spot_id
    print(max_spot_id)
    max_spot_id <<- max(df$Spot.ID, na.rm = T) # Update the variable in the parent environment by <<-
    return(df)
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Check for duplicate Spot IDs.
duplicated_spots <- raw_all_spots_data[duplicated(raw_all_spots_data$Spot.ID), ]

if (nrow(duplicated_spots) > 0) {
  message("Duplicate Spot IDs found:")
  print(duplicated_spots)
} else {
  message("No duplicate Spot IDs found.")
  
  # Export the data.
  dir.create("./output", showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  write.table(raw_all_spots_data,
              file = "./output/allspots_merged.csv",
              quote = FALSE,
              sep = ",",
              row.names = F)
    
    message("Exported allspots_merged.")
}
```

```{r modify}
spot_data <-
  raw_spot_data %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Frame = Frame + analysis_start_frame) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Area = Area*scale**2) # Convert area from pixels^2 to µm^2.

edge_data <- 
  raw_edge_data
```

```{r find_terminal_spots}
# Collect Spot IDs from the first frame.
# The current analysis includes as many cells from the first frame as possible.
a <- spot_data %>%
  filter(Frame == min(Frame)) %>% 
  select("Spot.ID")

First.Frame.Spot.ID <- as.list(a$Spot.ID)

# Define the first forward-traversal function.
my.func_1 <- function(x, y, pending) {
  SaveList <- append(y, x)
  pending <- pending
  
  if(!is.na(match(x, edge_data$Source.spot.ID))) {
    T_ID <- edge_data %>% 
      filter(Source.spot.ID == x) %>% 
      pull("Target.spot.ID") %>% 
      as.integer() # Convert to integer IDs.
  } else {
    return(list(SaveList = SaveList, pending = pending))
  }
  
  if(length(T_ID) > 1) {
    # If there are two daughter Spot IDs:
    # Follow one branch and add the other to the pending list.
    pending <- append(pending, T_ID[2])
    T_ID <- T_ID[1]
  }
  
  my.func_2(T_ID, SaveList, pending)
}

# Define the second forward-traversal function.
my.func_2 <- function(x, y, pending) {
  SaveList <- append(y, x)
  pending <- pending
  
  if(!is.na(match(x, edge_data$Source.spot.ID))) {
    T_ID <- edge_data %>% 
      filter(Source.spot.ID == x) %>% 
      pull("Target.spot.ID") %>% 
      as.integer() # Convert to integer IDs.
  } else {
    # If no next Spot is found, the current Spot is not connected to any subsequent Spot.
    # Since tracking in TrackMate was performed until the second cell division, terminate the analysis of this lineage when no next Spot is found.
    return(list(SaveList = SaveList, pending = pending))
  }
  
  if(length(T_ID) > 1) {
    # If there are two daughter Spot IDs:
    # Follow one branch and add the other to the pending list.
    pending <- append(pending, T_ID[2])
    T_ID <- T_ID[1]
  }
  
  my.func_1(T_ID, SaveList, pending)
}

# Start the traversal.
pending <- list() # List of branches awaiting processing.
result_list <- list() # List for storing traversal results.

# Process the initial Spot IDs.
result_list <- lapply(First.Frame.Spot.ID, function(id) {
  res <- my.func_1(id, list(), pending)
  pending <<- res$pending
  return(res$SaveList)
  }
)
print(paste("Initial pending length:", length(pending)))

# Process all pending branches.
while (length(pending) > 0) {
  next_pending <- pending
  pending <- list()
  result_list <- c(result_list, lapply(next_pending, function(id) {
    res <- my.func_1(id, list(), pending)
    pending <<- res$pending
    return(res$SaveList)
  }))
  print(paste("Pending length after loop:", length(pending)))
}

# Collect the terminal Spot ID from each tracked branch.
Last.Frame.Spot.ID <- lapply(result_list, function(lst) {
  return(tail(lst, n = 1)[[1]]) # Get the last element of each list.
})
```

```{r reconstruct_lineages}
# Daughter cells share their ancestral trajectory, so reconstruct each lineage backward from its terminal Spot.
# Starting the lineage reconstruction from the initial Spot would be more complicated.

# Pass a terminal Spot ID as x and an empty output list as y.
my.func_3 <- function(x, y) {
  SaveList <- append(y, x)
  
  while (!is.na(match(x, edge_data$Target.spot.ID))) { 
    ID <- edge_data %>%
      filter(Target.spot.ID == x) %>%
      pull("Source.spot.ID") %>%
      as.integer() # Convert to integer IDs.
    
    if(length(ID) == 1){
      SaveList <- append(SaveList, ID)
    } else {
      print(paste("source.ID", ID, sep = ":"))
      print(paste("target.ID", x, sep = ":"))
      mistake_edge <- edge_data[edge_data$Target.spot.ID == x,]
      print(mistake_edge)
      mistake_spot <- spot_data[spot_data$Spot.ID == ID[1] | spot_data$Spot.ID == ID[2] | spot_data$Spot.ID == x,]
      print(mistake_spot)
      ID <- ID[1]
      SaveList <- append(SaveList, ID)
    }
    
    x <- ID
  }
  
  return(SaveList)
}

list <- list() # Initialize an empty list.
Spot.genealogy <- lapply(Last.Frame.Spot.ID, my.func_3, list) # Store the Spot-ID sequence for each lineage. 

# Note: Spot IDs are initially ordered backward, from terminal to ancestral Spots.
```

```{r calculate_generations}
my.func_4 <- # Extract the area and division status for each Spot ID.
  function(x){  # x contains a list of Spot IDs.
    data <- # Retrieve the data for the specified Spot ID.
      spot_data %>% 
      dplyr::filter(Spot.ID == x) %>% 
      dplyr::select("Spot.ID", "Frame", "Area", "Quality")
    
    IF_Source <- # Find the row where the current Spot ID is the Target Spot ID, and retrieve the corresponding Source Spot ID.
      edge_data %>% 
      dplyr::filter(Target.spot.ID == x) %>% 
      dplyr::select("Source.spot.ID")
    if(is.na(as.integer(IF_Source)) == TRUE){ # If there is no Source Spot ID, this is an initial Spot.
      IF_Source[1, 1] <- NA
    }
    
    IF_Divided <- # Find all rows with the specified Source Spot ID.
      edge_data %>% 
      dplyr::filter(Source.spot.ID == as.character(IF_Source))
    
    # If one Target Spot is found, the cell has not divided. If two Target Spots are found, the cell has divided.
    Divide_data.frame <-
      createEmptyDf(0, 1, colnames = c("IF_Divided"))
    if(nrow(IF_Divided) == 1){
      Divide_data.frame[1, 1] <- "N"
    }else if(nrow(IF_Divided) == 2){
      Divide_data.frame[1, 1] <- "Y"
    }else if(nrow(IF_Divided) == 0) { # If IF_Divided is 0, the initial Spot has been reached.
      Divide_data.frame[1, 1] <- "N"
    }
    
    data <- dplyr::bind_cols(data, IF_Source, Divide_data.frame)
    
    return(data)
  }

my.func_5 <- # Build a lineage data frame from the extracted Spot measurements.
  function(x){ # x contains a list of Spot IDs.
    A_data.frame <-
      lapply(x, my.func_4) %>% 
      dplyr::bind_rows() %>% 
      arrange(Frame) %>% 
      mutate(Time = Frame * time_interval,
             generation_count = cumsum(IF_Divided == "Y"))
  }

genealogy_data <-
  lapply(Spot.genealogy, my.func_5) 
```

```{r export_setting}
# Assign a track number to each lineage and combine the data frames.
All_genealogy_data <- 
  lapply(seq_along(genealogy_data), function(i) {
    genealogy_data[[i]] %>%
      mutate(track = i)  # Add a track number to each lineage.
  }) %>%
  bind_rows() %>% # Combine all lineage data frames. 
  mutate(Area = ifelse(Quality == -1, NA, Area)) # Set area to NA for manually added Spots identified by Quality == -1.

# Export the data.
write.table(All_genealogy_data,
            file = "./output/All_genealogy_data.csv",
            quote = FALSE,
            sep = ",",
            row.names = F)
```
